text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Reality is full of all sorts of "lip 
service."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You, and you, and even you are the 
protagonist." ...As if to say, there are 
no side characters.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, the protagonist of a manga is 
decided the moment they appear.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa~ So this rival was fighting to carry 
on his older brother's will... *sniff*... 
Man, this really brings tears to my eyes~"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “—Now, what will our protagonist do?!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how much supporting 
characters add color to a story, it's the 
'protagonist' who stands at its center.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is the one who makes the 
story exciting. The protagonist is the one 
who drives the story forward.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I want to surpass Almond Eye! I want to 
win! I want to rewrite history!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if you are a protagonist so dazzling 
it blinds! I will create an even greater 
thrill with these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is—our 'story'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhーー!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Kiseki! Kiseki still holds the lead 
from her runaway break!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Pulling away! Pulling away! Shaking off 
the fierce pursuit of the Triple Tiara 
Umamusume! Kiseki keeps charging straight 
ahead—...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Goooooooooal in!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………I won.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I won—...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...You really are incredible after all, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I lost. To you. ...To you—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations.........!

Celebratory confetti rains down onto the 
turf.

Surrounded by that vibrant scenery, the 
two, having given it their all, pulled 
each other into a firm embrace and praised 
one another's valiant efforts.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

I reached out with my right hand toward 
Kiseki as she made her way into the 
winner's circle.
choice_data_list: Come over here! Get closer to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heh—
(WOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd win with a runaway lead! 
Just how entertaining of an Umamusume are 
you?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was fun! My heart was racing until 
the very end!! The race you gave me... was 
the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Kiseki! Keep giving it your 
all! Show us another great race! Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Waaah...!
choice_data_list:
You're the one who created this deeply 
moving moment.

You're the one who created this deeply 
moving moment.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Did you have fun too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Were you super thrilled?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, my heart's been pounding the whole 
time.
Yeah, my heart was racing the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Have you become completely captivated by 
the creations I make?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That's right! Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I am the protagonist!! The protagonist of 
a true masterpiece...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I didn't give up...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad... I can stand here...!

"Even if that reply doesn't take voice, 
her feelings come through loud and clear."

The conclusion we reached together. Kiseki 
had—triumphed over Almond Eye.
